sentences.text: Peter Davison -LRB- born Peter Malcolm Gordon Moffett on 13 April 1951 -RRB- is an English actor with many credits in television dramas and sitcoms .

He became famous as Tristan Farnon in the BBC 's television adaptation of James Herriot 's All Creatures Great and Small stories .	James Herriot	James Herriot	All Creatures Great and Small	All Creatures Great and Small (TV series)

His subsequent starring roles included the sitcoms Holding the Fort and Sink or Swim , the fifth incarnation of the Doctor in Doctor Who , Dr. Stephen Daker in A Very Peculiar Practice and Albert Campion in Campion .	Holding the Fort	Holding the Fort	Sink or Swim	Sink or Swim (TV series)	fifth incarnation	Fifth Doctor	the Doctor	Doctor (Doctor Who)	Doctor Who	Doctor Who	A Very Peculiar Practice	A Very Peculiar Practice	Campion	Campion (TV series)

He later played David Braithwaite in At Home with the Braithwaites , `` Dangerous '' Davies in The Last Detective and Henry Sharpe in Law & Order : UK .	At Home with the Braithwaites	At Home with the Braithwaites	The Last Detective	The Last Detective
